description:

title: Supervisor, Unapplied Cash Research
description:

title: Article Trainee
description:
**Company Description**
PSB AND CO, Chartered Accountants, is a professional services firm specializing in audit, accounting, taxation, and advisory services for a diverse range of clients. The firm is committed to delivering accurate, timely, and compliant financial solutions that support client growth and long-term stability. PSB AND CO emphasizes practical learning, ethical conduct, and technical excellence in all engagements. Team members work in a collaborative environment that supports continuous professional development and exposure to varied industries and assignments.

This is a full-time, on-site Article Trainee role based in Chengalpattu. The Article Trainee will assist in statutory and internal audits, preparation and review of financial statements, and maintenance of accounting records under the supervision of senior team members. Daily tasks may include supporting tax computations and filings, performing vouching and verification of financial data, and helping with documentation and working papers for various client assignments. * Ability to use accounting or ERP software and good proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and related tools.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills to interact with team members and clients professionally.
* Ability to learn quickly, follow instructions, and manage time and workload to meet deadlines.
* Commitment to professional ethics, integrity, and maintaining confidentiality of client information.
* Willingness to work on-site in Chengalpattu and travel to client locations as required.

title: Treasury and CRM Specialist
company: Metivo — a Part of BASF Group
description:
Leveraging its deep expertise as the global leader in catalysis and precious metals, BASF Environmental Catalyst and Metal Solutions (ECMS) serves customers in many industries including automotive, aerospace, indoor air quality, semiconductors and hydrogen economy, and provides full loop services with its precious metals trading and recycling offering. With a focus on circular solutions and sustainability, ECMS is committed to helping our customers create a cleaner, more sustainable world. Protecting our elements of life is our purpose and this inspires us to ever-new solutions. ECMS operates globally in 15 countries with approximately 20 production sites and over 4,000 employees.
  
  
**About the Role / Job Purpose**

* Responsible for execution of cash management and foreign currency hedging of the legal entity
* Preparation of monthly liquidity forecast reports of legal entity
* Ensure compliance with internal and external rules and regulations and corporate governance
* Serve as expert for cash and foreign exchange management as well as money market and currency market development
* Engage with internal and external partners to focus innovations.
* Take initiatives to streamline or re-engineer treasury processes towards digitalization and best practice standards

Main Task

Initiate deal entries in SAP and work closely with Back Office to ensure smooth execution, settlement and accounting entries

**Preparation of monthly liquidity forecast reports of assigned companies**

* Prepare 6-month rolling cash flow forecast on monthly basis for designated companies based on business trends and working capital KPIs
* Improve continuously on forecast accuracy by knowledge sharing and contribution to global liquidity planning community

**Ensure compliance with internal and external rules and regulations and corporate governance**

* Strictly follow Group guidelines, policies and procedures in conducting all Front Office operation
* Ensure full compliance with external regulation for all cash management and foreign currency transactions
* Support internal and external auditing of Front Office operation

**Serve as expert for cash and foreign exchange management as well as money market and currency market development for assigned countries in Asia Pacific**

* Monitor macroeconomic development in assigned countries
* Monitor money market and currency market development of assigned countries and contribute to cash management and hedging strategies development jointly with CFT.
* Provide advisory services to team members as well as non-treasury colleagues

**Take initiatives to streamline or re-engineer treasury processes towards digitalization and best practice standards**

* Review regularly AS-IS operational work flows and identify improvement areas
* Maintain relationship with internal and external business partners, identify new opportunities in operational efficiency
* Identify areas for digitalization to optimize/ improve data transparency and process efficiency

**Represent as Regional Treasury in global and regional projects for cash and foreign currency management topics**

* Collaborate with global and regional relevant units (e.g. Treasury Middle Office, Back Office, Process Experts) in cash and foreign currency management projects
* Provide cash and currency management expertise and support to other projects as required

**CRM Related:**

* According to global and regional CRM guidelines, perform periodic credit risk analysis and monitor risk development and KPIs for India customers
* Responsible for and ensure quality and timely completion of periodic CRM related reports in close collaboration with local Business Units, and controllers
* Proactive Order Management (market principle, excluding prepayment/tech),prompt review and actions according to guidelines
* Support global l CRM projects by sharing country specific CRM knowledge.
* Review current CRM processes and drive continuous process improvement to maximize efficiency and maintain proper risk control
* Work very closely with Global Credit Management colleagues for specific projects
* Liaise with the Internal and External statutory auditors for the area of responsibilities.

**Education:**

* Education: CA
* Working Experience: 3 -7 years’ experience in the area of credit risk management, cash management and foreign exchange trading and risk management preferably in automobile industry
* Knowledge in SAP and advance computer skills in MS Office application

**Desired:**

* Profound understanding and operation experience in finance and treasury such as cash forecasting, pooling, netting, bank deposits, loans, money market, foreign currency derivatives as well as local finance related regulatory framework and environment in major Asia countries
* Ability in developing and analysing cash flow statement and liquidity forecast plans
* Proficient skills in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SAP, 360T, , Bloomberg and Power BI
* High proficiency in English with strong communication and interpersonal skill

title: Divisional Merchandise Manager
company: Eastman Exports Global Clothing Pvt Ltd.,
description:
**Company Description**
Eastman Exports Global Clothing Pvt Ltd. is a leading apparel manufacturer recognized for its strong product development capabilities and customer-focused approach. Guided by the vision and leadership of its founder, the company has grown from modest beginnings to an annual business volume of around USD $300 million. Cross-functional teams work in close coordination to ensure high operational efficiency and reliable delivery. A creative design and product development team continuously monitors global fashion and high-street trends to provide relevant, high-quality garment solutions. The company is committed to delivering garments that meet customer expectations for quality, fit, and timely service.
  
**Role Description**
The Divisional Merchandise Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Tiruppur, responsible for overseeing merchandising strategy and execution for assigned product categories. This role involves planning seasonal assortments, driving sales and margin performance, and aligning product offerings with market trends and customer requirements. The manager will collaborate closely with design, production, sales, and sourcing teams to develop collections, manage inventory levels, and ensure timely order fulfillment. Daily activities include analyzing sales reports, monitoring stock performance, optimizing product mix, and maintaining strong relationships with key customers and internal stakeholders. The role also includes guiding junior merchandising staff, supporting price negotiations, and contributing to long-term business growth through data-driven decisions.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders and present merchandising plans clearly.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and relationship management skills to understand buyer needs, respond to inquiries, and ensure high levels of client satisfaction.
* Candidates should possess Sales and commercial acumen, with experience in driving category performance, managing margins, and supporting negotiations.
* Candidates should possess Inventory Management and Assortment planning skills to balance stock levels, minimize aged inventory, and build profitable product ranges.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Fashion Merchandising, Textile Technology, Business, or a related field are preferred.
* Experience in apparel manufacturing or garment export merchandising, strong analytical skills, and proficiency in MS Excel or merchandising systems will be beneficial.
* Ability to work collaboratively on-site in a fast-paced environment, with strong problem-solving, time management, and decision-making capabilities.

title: Supervisor, Accounts Receivable
description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
  
  
**Come Join Our Team!**

* As part of our robust Rewards & Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**

* We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Healthcare RCM Supervisor, Accounts Receivable, to oversee our accounts receivable department. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, a comprehensive understanding of healthcare revenue cycle management, and a proven track record of optimizing accounts receivable processes. The Supervisor will be responsible for managing a team of AR specialists, ensuring timely and accurate billing, claims processing, payment posting, and denial management.

**Essential Functions And Tasks**

* Lead and manage a team of accounts receivable specialists, providing guidance, support, and coaching to ensure high performance and productivity.
* Develop and implement strategies to optimize the accounts receivable process, reduce aging of accounts, and improve cash flow.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics related to accounts receivable, such as days in accounts receivable (AR days), denial rates, and cash collection ratios, and take proactive measures to address any deviations from targets.
* Oversee the billing and claims processing functions, ensuring that claims are submitted accurately and timely, and that any issues or errors are promptly addressed and resolved.
* Manage payment posting activities, reconciling payments received with billed charges, and identifying and addressing any discrepancies or variances.
* Coordinate denial management efforts, analyzing denial trends, implementing corrective actions, and appealing denials as necessary to maximize revenue recovery.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as coding, billing, and compliance, to ensure alignment and consistency in revenue cycle processes and workflows.
* Stay informed about changes and updates in healthcare regulations, payer policies, and industry trends related to accounts receivable management, and implement necessary changes to ensure compliance and optimization.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews, providing feedback, recognition, and development opportunities to team members.
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a point of contact for escalated issues and inquiries from internal stakeholders, external partners, and patients related to accounts receivable matters.
* Keep accurate records of accounts receivable activities, performance metrics, and outcomes, and generate reports as needed to track progress and measure success.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with a focus on accounts receivable.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Previous leadership experience, preferably in a healthcare setting.
* In-depth knowledge of medical billing processes, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong understanding of healthcare payer policies and claims adjudication processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively lead and motivate a team.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and achieving objectives.
* Proficiency in healthcare revenue cycle management software and systems.
* Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR) certification is a plus.
* Willingness to stay updated on industry trends and best practices through continuing education and professional development opportunities.

title: Head of Finance
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
A. Financial Planning, MIS & Business Performance
  

· Own the Company's overall financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance management process.

· Prepare and present monthly/quarterly MIS, P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow reports to Management.

· Establish appropriate financial KPIs and dashboards for the refining/recycling and real-estate businesses.

· Analyse actual performance against budget, forecast and previous periods and highlight significant variances.

· Provide management with actionable insights on profitability, margins, cash flows and financial risks.

· Develop business-unit-wise profitability analysis.

· Support management in evaluating new business opportunities, investments and expansion plans.

· Establish robust financial controls and reporting systems as the Company scales.

B. P&L, Balance Sheet & Financial Control
  

· Take complete ownership of the Company's P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow.

· Ensure accuracy, completeness and timely closure of monthly and annual accounts.

· Review provisions, accruals, depreciation, inventory valuation, receivables, payables and other balance-sheet items.

· Strengthen balance-sheet controls and ensure appropriate reconciliation of all major accounts.

· Monitor financial health and identify potential risks/issues before they impact the business.

· Ensure adequate internal controls over financial transactions and accounting processes.

C. Precious Metal Refining / E-Waste & Industrial Waste Business
  

· Monitor metal recovery yields, refining costs and processing costs.

· Monitor precious-metal inventory and metal movement.

· Monitor inventory valuation and reconciliation of physical quantities with accounting records.

· Analyse margins based on input material, recovery rates, refining costs and realised metal values.

· Monitor purchase and processing economics for e-waste and industrial waste.

· Work closely with Operations and Procurement to identify cost leakages, process inefficiencies and margin improvement opportunities.

· Establish appropriate controls over high-value inventory and precious metals.

· Monitor exposure arising from fluctuations in precious-metal prices and foreign exchange, wherever applicable.

· Develop MIS covering material input → recovery → refining → sale → margin.

D. Working Capital & Cash Flow Management
  

· Drive effective management of working capital and cash flows.

· Monitor receivables, payables, inventory and cash conversion cycle.

· Establish robust cash-flow forecasting and liquidity planning.

· Closely monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables.

· Develop appropriate credit-control mechanisms and customer exposure limits.

· Optimise vendor payment cycles while maintaining supplier relationships.

· Ensure adequate liquidity for operational and strategic requirements.

· Provide regular cash-flow updates to Management.

E. Accounts Receivable & Payable
  

· Establish strong processes for receivables and collections.

· Monitor ageing and overdue receivables and ensure timely follow-up.

· Review customer credit limits and commercial terms from a financial-risk perspective.

· Ensure timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices and payments.

· Monitor ageing of payables and optimise payment planning.

· Strengthen controls around vendor onboarding, approvals and payments.

F. Direct & Indirect Taxation
  

· Oversee all Income Tax matters, including tax planning, assessments, returns and compliance.

· Coordinate with external tax advisors and consultants where required.

· Ensure timely completion of tax audits, assessments and related proceedings.

· Identify legitimate tax-planning opportunities while maintaining full compliance.

· Ensure complete and timely GST compliance, including returns, reconciliations and related statutory requirements.

· Monitor GST input-credit eligibility and utilisation.

· Ensure appropriate GST treatment of transactions across the refining/recycling and real-estate businesses.

· Coordinate GST audits, notices and assessments.

· Ensure proper reconciliation between books, GST returns and relevant transaction data.

G. FEMA, FDI & International Transactions
  

· Ensure compliance with applicable FEMA and RBI regulations relating to the Company's foreign exchange transactions.

· Oversee compliance relating to FDI, foreign investments, foreign remittances and related reporting, wherever applicable.

· Coordinate with authorised dealer banks, legal/tax advisors and other professionals for FEMA-related matters.

· Ensure timely filing of applicable statutory/regulatory returns and documentation.

· Advise Management on financial and regulatory implications of cross-border transactions.

H. Budgeting & Cost Control
  

· Lead the annual budgeting process across all business verticals.

· Establish departmental and business-unit budgets.

· Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets.

· Identify cost overruns and implement corrective measures.

· Develop systems for cost monitoring and cost optimisation.

· Analyse manufacturing/refining and administrative costs and identify opportunities for efficiency improvement.

· Ensure appropriate approval mechanisms for capital expenditure and operating expenditure.

I. Audit, Governance & Compliance
  

· Coordinate with Statutory Auditors, Internal Auditors, Tax Auditors and other professional advisors.

· Ensure timely completion of statutory audits and financial reporting.

· Strengthen internal financial controls and processes.

· Ensure compliance with applicable provisions of the Companies Act, Income Tax, GST, FEMA and other relevant laws/regulations.

· Establish appropriate delegation of authority and financial approval controls.

· Ensure proper documentation and audit trails for significant transactions.

description:

Ltd, Korea, a manufacturer of large plastic injection moulds (100 to 2,200 tonnage) for leading 2-wheeler, 4-wheeler and consumer electronics OEMs. Our Hosur plant handles in-house mould design, manufacturing and trials, and works closely with our Korea HQ and USA Business team on global projects.

* Prepare commercial invoices and packing lists for exports to Korea; manage exports under LUT
* Track inward/outward remittances, import realisation and inter-company payments with Korea HQ through the bank (forex portal)

* Prepare business visa support letters and coordinate travel bookings for staff deputed to Korea and customer sites

* Organised, follows up persistently, and comfortable handling multiple deadlines

* Exposure to a global tooling group with operations in Korea, India and North America
* Direct working with senior management

Hosur (on-site)

Immediate

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**
* The Bank Reconciliation Specialist is responsible for performing the initial steps in the payment posting process. Daily assignments are provided by the supervisor, and the specialist must develop a plan to complete assigned worklists by the end of each day. The Bank Reconciliation Specialist must comply with applicable billing standards and operate effectively in a team\-oriented environment, delivering superior service to providers across the country.


**Essential Functions And Tasks**
* Create monthly reconciliations for individual clients. (Monthly)
* Log into bank portals to download bank statements using Month\-to\-Date filtering and save them to the designated client folder for the current month. (Daily)
* Download Lockbox and Correspondence files. (Daily)
* Rename Lockbox and Correspondence files according to standard file naming conventions and upload them to the document management system. (Daily)
* Input new daily deposit totals from the previous business day for dashboard reporting. (Daily)
* Place prior day deposits on the client's monthly reconciliation log. (Daily)
* Update post logs daily for current and prior month reconciliations to ensure alignment with the bank statements. (Daily)
* Research and upload any missing remits for posting. (Daily)
* Investigate and resolve posting variances found in the bank statement. (Daily/Weekly)
* Perform daily checks to identify any remits not posted within 3 days and coordinate with the posting team for timely completion. (Daily/Weekly)
* Investigate and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve any variances identified in the reconciliation logs. (Weekly/Monthly)
* Monitor daily ERA checks to ensure they are posting automatically; notify the supervisor if any ERAs are not being received. (Daily/Weekly)
* Provide insurance and check details for ERA setups when necessary. (Weekly/Monthly)
* Review and compare reported deposits against Bank Statement totals to verify that all data is accurate, reconciled, and up\-to\-date. (Weekly)
* Identify Ventra and Non\-Ventra payments.
* Ensure all daily, weekly, and monthly tasks are completed accurately and do not require rework or cross\-checking. (Daily/Weekly/Monthly)


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* High School Diploma or GED.
* At least one (1\) year of experience reconciling bank account deposits.
* Knowledge of payor portals is preferred.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Ability to read, understand, and apply state/federal laws, regulations, and policies.
* Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner.
* Ability to remain flexible and work within a collaborative and fast paced environment.
* Basic use of computer, telephone, internet, copier, fax, and scanner.
* Basic touch 10 key skills.
* Basic Math skills.
* Understand and comply with company policies and procedures.
* Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong time management and organizational skills.
* Strong knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel (pivot tables), and database software skills.


**Compensation**
* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons .
* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentiv e bon us in accordance with company policies .

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Posting Title**
 Assistant Manager
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 The Assistant Manager at GKN Driveline (India) Limited will support the departmental head in overseeing daily operations, optimizing processes, and ensuring team performance aligns with company objectives and production targets within the Indian market.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key responsibilities
   

  

 Tax
   

  

 Deliver preestablished outcomes for designated tax areas by working within established tax
   

  

 systems.
   

  

 Data Collection and Analysis
   

  

 Collate and analyze data using preset tools, methods, and formats. Involves working
   

  

 independently.
   

  

 Data Management
   

  

 Use data management systems to access specific information as and when required.
   

  

 Insights and Reporting
   

  

 Extract and combine data to generate standard reports.
   

  

 Document Preparation
   

  

 Prepare moderately complex documents using a variety of applications for technology
   

  

 devices, such as standard office software. Also responsible for gathering and summarizing
   

  

 data for reports.
   

  

 Financial Policies, Guidelines, and Protocols
   

  

 Assist with the development and delivery of financial policies, guidelines, and protocols to
   

  

 ensure the company complies with regulations and good financial practice.
   

  

 Recommendations
   

  

 Provide information and clarification on existing procedures, processes, and precedents.
   

  

 Financial Management and Control
   

  

 Monitor and analyze data using established finance systems and protocols.
   

  

 Operational Compliance
   

  

 Develop own capabilities by participating in assessment and development planning activities
   

  

 as well as formal and informal training and coaching. Develop and maintain an
   

  

 understanding of relevant technology, external regulation, and industry best practices
   

  

 through ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media.
   

  

 Leadership and Direction
   

  

 Supervise a team performing routine work.
   

  

 Performance Management
   

  

 Prioritize own workflow and ensure work is completed to the required standards of
   

  

 productivity, quality, and timeliness; use performance management systems to improve
   

  

 personal performance.
   

  

**Required Skills And Education**
 Education
   

  

 Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Level
   

  

 Experience enables job holder to deal with the majority of situations and to advise others
   

  

 (Over 3 years to 6 years)
   

  

**About Dauch**
 Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain\-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries \- GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Visit www.dauch.com to learn more.
